description: Dependency updates for both ecosystems, weekly and reviewable (VLD-ANB-MIDGARD-0076). See docs/dev/CI.md, "Dependency updates".
Every update is a pull or merge request against a pinned file: the pnpm and npm lockfiles, Cargo.lock with /vendor, action commit SHAs, image digests. Nothing floats and nothing merges itself.

github-actions.description: Actions stay pinned to a full commit SHA, with the release named in a trailing comment.

gitlabci.description: GitLab job images and services stay pinned by digest.

customManagers.description: The digest-pinned base images of the Dockerfiles under deploy/ (FROM name:tag@sha256:... or ARG NAME=name:tag@sha256:...).

packageRules.description: The launch-media tooling: a maintainer-workstation tool outside the pnpm workspace and the release gate, kept current all the same (VLD-ANB-MIDGARD-0050, 0062).
The base images under deploy/ take digest refreshes of the tag they already name; a new tag (a new Rust or Node line) is a deliberate change, not a weekly one.

Crates are vendored and the build is offline, so Cargo.lock cannot be updated against the registry in place. These tasks run ONLY on a self-hosted Renovate whose global allowedCommands admits them; hosted Renovate opens the pull request with the manifest change, and a maintainer finishes it by hand (docs/dev/CI.md, "Dependency updates"). Until /vendor matches Cargo.lock, the vendor job fails the pull request.
Held for Rust 1.82: zeroize 1.9 and base64ct 1.7 need edition 2024 (docs/dev/BUILD_ENV.md).
